### STEP 1 — Scene
A rice-and-chicken curry meal with a separate creamy mixed salad and water. The wrapped object at the front is not identifiable as food, so I exclude it.

### STEP 2 — Vessels
- **Main shallow bowl:** approximately 23 cm diameter; area = 3.14 × 11.5² = **415 cm²**.
- **Salad bowl:** approximately 19 cm diameter; area = 3.14 × 9.5² = **283 cm²**.

### STEPS 3–6 — Items, area, volume and weight
Percentages represent estimated non-overlapping portions of each vessel’s area. Heights are average pile thicknesses.

| Vessel / visible item | Area share | Area × height = gross volume | Density | Weight |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Main: cooked rice | 38% | 158 × 1.9 = 300 ml | 0.8 | 240 g |
| Main: chicken pieces | 22% | 91 × 1.4 = 128 ml | 0.95 | 122 g |
| Main: yellow curry sauce | 15% | 62 × 0.65 = 40 ml | 1.0 | 40 g |
| Main: vegetables in curry | 5% | 21 × 0.9 = 19 ml | 0.6 | 11 g |
| Salad: cucumber, tomato and greens | 30% | 85 × 1.4 = 119 ml | 0.6 | 71 g |
| Salad: dark beans | 12% | 34 × 1.2 = 41 ml | 0.8 | 33 g |
| Salad: white cheese-like pieces | 6% | 17 × 0.9 = 15 ml | 1.0 | 15 g |
| Salad: creamy dressing | 7% | 20 × 0.6 = 12 ml | 1.0 | 12 g |

**Coverage check:** main bowl 80%; salad bowl 55%. Both are plausible given the visible empty rims. Dressing and sauce estimates include their visible coatings; no additional oil is added.

### STEP 7 — Energy
The chicken, cheese and sauce identifications are approximate.

| Item | kcal/100 g | Estimated kcal |
|---|---:|---:|
| Cooked rice | 130 | 312 |
| Chicken pieces | 175 | 214 |
| Curry sauce | 150 | 60 |
| Curry vegetables | 40 | 4 |
| Salad vegetables | 22 | 16 |
| Cooked beans | 120 | 40 |
| White cheese | 265 | 40 |
| Creamy dressing | 300 | 36 |

### STEP 8 — Sanity check
**Estimated food total: 644 g and 722 kcal**, excluding water and the unidentified wrapped item. About 413 g of curry and rice plus 131 g of salad is consistent with the visible portions. A reasonable uncertainty is roughly ±25%, especially for sauce and dressing energy.
